author: YukonDeadpool
body:
Also really depends on how you’re allocating resources and playing the game. Are you finishing a lot of quests or dungeons? I spent the $7 to buy 5 keys the first time, but I’ve never had to again, up to around 30 keys and dungeons can be big orn.

Have you built a town hall to give you jobs? Are you finishing jobs at inns?

I accidentally blew 100,000 orn renaming a region thinking it was free, AND someone told me I would retain the spells from specialization changes so I blew some Orns there. Don’t waste them!

Looking at the stats for some of the level 6 classes I’m happy with Spellsword at level 131 anyway.

author: Mousermind
body:
The main thing is to avoid spending Orns on *anything* but one class per Tier, and focusing on Achievements (Herbalist alone grants you 90k+ Orns after 2k potions, such as Elixirs), Dungeons/Gauntlets, and Arena Sparring. Kingdom Raids can easily throw off your XP-Orn ratio, as can XP-boosting items. When you watch your Orns in early levels you'll be fine, and eventually you'll have extra Orns to spend on things other than classes.

Obviously, always use your Lucky Silver Coins and any other Orn-boosting gear you might have, though I'd stay away from RoR, since it only chokes off your potential and isn't worth the sacrifice in the long run.

author: [deleted]
body:
It is a struggle, imo up until T9. I would honestly avoid Monster Tomes as you will outlevel your class so quickly and run in to problems. If you exclusively level in boss gauntlets it isn't as bad, but you barely keep up. I've power leveled alts that way with my main, and they generally only have a bit to spare.

Something that can help: check out the achievements. You may be able to get a big boost in orns for a small investment, such as Student or Polymath achievements. Grinding those and the other achievements is helpful. I do think T9 was the first time I was ahead. At T8 I was just a little behind, but I was leveling purely on bosses at that point (I got 100k boss kills before 60k monster kills). T9 to T10 you will have orns to spare.
